```{r}

install.packages("sf")
install.packages("stars")
install.packages("tmap")

```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(tmap)
```


```{r}
# read in geodatabase of EJScreen data at the Census Block Group level
ejscreen <- sf::st_read(here::here("EDS223-HW1", "data", "ejscreen","EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb"))
```

```{r}
glimpse(ejscreen)
colnames(ejscreen)


```

```{r}
# Select a smaller area to work with
california <- ejscreen |>
  filter(ST_ABBREV=="CA") 
```
```{r}
sd <- ejscreen |>
  filter(CNTY_NAME %in% c("San Diego County")) 
```
```{r}
slo <- ejscreen |>
  filter(CNTY_NAME %in% c("San Luis Obispo County")) 
```
```{r}
tm_shape(slo) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "PM25")
```

```{r}
tm_shape(slo)+ 
  tm_polygons(fill = "D2_CANCER") 
```

```{r}
tm_shape(slo)+ 
  tm_polygons(fill = "CANCER") 
```
